description: This file defines a REST API resource for managing 'Standing Instructions' for account transfers in a banking application. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and listing standing instructions, as well as retrieving templates for instruction creation. The file utilizes JAX-RS annotations for REST endpoints, Swagger annotations for API documentation, and references various services and data classes related to standing instructions.

classes.name: StandingInstructionApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing standing instructions, including creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and listing instructions, along with template retrieval functionality.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Retrieves a template for creating or maintaining standing instructions, including default values and allowed options.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new standing instruction based on provided JSON request.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates or deletes an existing standing instruction, based on the command parameter.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all standing instructions based on search and filter parameters.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific standing instruction, with optional included associations such as transactions or template data.
